# @use-gpu/math

```sh
npm install --save @use-gpu/math
```

```sh
yarn add @use-gpu/math
```

**Docs**: https://usegpu.live/docs/reference-library-@use-gpu-math

# Use.GPU - Math

Pure math helpers in JS for:
- Polynomial solving
- Bezier splines
- Catmull-Rom splines
- Animation easing

## Colofon

Made by [Steven Wittens](https://acko.net). Part of `@use-gpu`.
